state_reads: supported evasion, protection, and menace restrictions
whole-line static restrictions over effective type, supertype, subtype, token status, keyword, color, power, toughness, goad, attachment, controller, and public combat relationships
defending-player, attacking-player, and source-controller battlefield existence, tapped-state, minimum-count, and relative-count conditions
costs: whole-line fixed ordinary-mana intrinsic, attached, and global block taxes are locked and paid atomically
represented manual or automatic mana plans use the ordinary mana-ability payment path
optional, nonmana, variable, alternative, modified, and broader conditional block costs remain blocked
timing: ordinary declaration is a turn-based action
all defending players declare in turn order
active player receives priority after declarations
targets: a blocker may be assigned only to an attacker attacking that defender or an object they defend
choices: each defending player chooses zero or more legal blocks
a menace attacker receives zero or at least two blockers
not-alone, minimum/maximum blocker-count, and table-wide count restrictions are inviolable
the declaration must maximize represented block requirements only within the restriction-obeying declaration space
hidden_information: blocker declarations use public combat and battlefield information
apnap: multiplayer defending players are prompted sequentially in turn order
layers: effective types, keywords, colors, and protection are read through derived characteristics
copy: copies use their effective combat characteristics
control_change: a submitted blocker must still be controlled by the declaring defender
zone_change: a blocker must still be on the battlefield when the declaration is validated
source_leaves: a blocked attacker remains blocked after all its blockers leave

rulings: Mogg Flunkies — 2018-03-16 — The other blocker need not block the same attacker.
Wandering Wolf — 2012-05-01 — The power comparison occurs only as blockers are declared.
Prehistoric Pet — 2026-01-27 — Once blocked, later power changes do not make it unblocked.
Mindless Null — 2009-10-01 — The Vampire condition matters only as blockers are declared; losing Vampires afterward does not undo the block.
